title: Cyanotype project spec
description: cyanotype.yaml: the user's choices, never the generated text. Editor support only: the tool validates the file with its own Go code, and checks selections against the catalog separately. See the Project spec section of docs/DESIGN.md.

version.description: Version of the spec format. Older versions are migrated; newer ones need a newer cyanotype.

catalog_version.description: Catalog version the spec was generated with, such as "2026.10". Quote it: unquoted, YAML reads it as a number. Omit it to use the catalog bundled with cyanotype.

targets.description: Agents whose instruction files are generated and committed.

mode.description: Interface mode the choices were last made in. Defaults to advanced.

project.description: Short summary of what is being built; it goes into the main instruction file.

goal.description: What the project is for, in one or two sentences.

out_of_scope.description: What the agent must not build. Prevents a lot of unrequested work.

brief.description: Path of the full product description relative to the project root, with forward slashes, such as docs/PRODUCT.md.

languages.description: Human language of each kind of text the agent writes. Each defaults to english.

agent_replies.description: The agent's replies to the user.

commands.description: The project's own commands, listed in the main instruction file. Each is optional and on one line.

dev.description: Starts the project for development, such as pnpm dev.

build.description: Builds the project, such as go build ./....

test.description: Runs the tests, such as pnpm test.

lint.description: Runs the linter, such as golangci-lint run.

selections.description: Selected catalog entry ids. Order matters: entries appear in generated text in this order.

locked.description: Selected entry ids that a personal cyanotype.local.yaml may not weaken or remove.

i18n.description: Translation settings of the app being built.

default_locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the default locale, such as en or pt-BR.

locales.description: Every supported locale, including the default one. Defaults to the default locale only.

translations_by.description: Who translates: the agent drafts every locale, the agent writes the default locale only, or human translators. Defaults to agent-draft.

answers.description: Free-text answers to open questions, keyed by question id, such as domain_notes.

custom_rules.description: Rules the catalog cannot know, each with its reason.

why.description: The reason behind the rule, in short form.

locked.description: Stops a personal cyanotype.local.yaml from overriding the rule.

split.description: auto splits only when the main file would exceed max_lines; always and never force it. Defaults to auto.

max_lines.description: Main file length above which auto splits. Defaults to 100.

topic_dir.description: Folder for topic files relative to the project root, with forward slashes. Defaults to docs/agents.
